recommendedTitle: ops(ci): mint PROJECT_TOKEN so issue-on-dev.yml moves the kanban Status
summary: Sai: agents add the `on-dev` label instead of setting the project Status; `gh project item-edit` is the correct command. Root cause: issue-on-dev.yml always labelled and only moved Status when ON_DEV_PROJECT_NUMBER + PROJECT_TOKEN were set — the variable was unset and the secret missing, so every dev merge produced label-only. The workflow has been rewritten to be Status-only (no label) with the variable set to 9; the only remaining gap is minting the PROJECT_TOKEN secret.
currentBehavior: issue-on-dev.yml: finds referenced issues (closing keywords AND `Issues: #N` line), moves them to 'On dev' via gh project item-edit, then comments. Without PROJECT_TOKEN it logs the skip and still comments.
rootCause: GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write org projects; without the fine-grained PROJECT_TOKEN secret the Status move step was silently skipped and the label was the visible proxy.
resolution: Mint a fine-grained PAT with Projects read/write scoped to the CHS backlog project and set it as the repo secret PROJECT_TOKEN. Until then the project-on-dev-status skill backfills merges.
acceptanceCriteria: A dev-merge PR moves its referenced issues to the 'On dev' Status
